```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.IESpace eSpace) => {
    // IServerEntitySignature (System)/User
    var user = (OutSystems.Model.Data.IServerEntitySignature)eSpace.AddDependency(Services.ModelServices.ParseGlobalKey("SyNtHeTiCsYsTeMaAaAaAa*DeMoKeY00000000000012"));
    
    /*** creating IServerAction 'OnSignInReady' ***/
    var onSignInReady = eSpace.CreateServerAction("OnSignInReady");
    onSignInReady.Description = "OnSignInReady (synthetic)";
    
    var startNode = onSignInReady.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    var getUser = onSignInReady.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IAggregateNode>("GetUser");
    var userSource = getUser.Aggregate.AddSource(user);
    startNode.Target = getUser;
    var logVisit2 = eSpace.ServerActions.Named("LogVisit");
    var logVisit = onSignInReady.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteServerActionNode>("LogVisit");
    logVisit.Action = logVisit2;
    getUser.Target = logVisit;
    var endNode = onSignInReady.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    logVisit.Target = endNode;
}
```
